items.guidance: Check the `postgresql` service in docker-compose/deploy/docker-compose.yml for its image and command; if it is a stock PostgreSQL image with no app code, map it to the Deployz managed PostgreSQL. Report which database variables the `lobe` service's environment block reads (for example DATABASE_URL or similar), so Deployz can inject them under those names.

In this Next.js app, look under the app router's api directories for an existing health, ping, or status route handler, and check that it is reachable without login. If none exists, add a minimal GET route handler returning 200 at a path such as /api/health. Exclude that path in the Next.js middleware matcher or its auth/locale logic so the probe on port 3210 is not redirected.
